summary: Accounten is a family-run Sydney accounting practice founded in 2020 by Amanda Ying and Jonathan So, offering bookkeeping, virtual CFO, audit preparation and payroll with no lock-in contracts. Its team is spread across Australia, India and the Philippines and it works in Xero. Little recent public activity (no blog posts, podcasts or job ads) was found.

claims.text: Accounten's own website describes it as a modern tax and accounting firm.
claims.quote: Welcome to Accounten, where old-school meets new-school in the world of tax and accounting!

claims.text: Amanda Ying is currently Director and Co-founder of Accounten, based in Sydney, since Sep 2020.
Accounten was started in 2020 by a brother and sister and is a family-run firm.
claims.quote: And so, in 2020, Accounten was born.

claims.text: Amanda has over 7 years of audit and assurance experience plus over 10 years in business services and taxation.
claims.quote: she has over 7 years of audit and assurance experience coupled with over 10 years of business services and taxation experience.

claims.text: Accounten offers audit preparation, building work papers and reconciliations to suit each audit.
claims.quote: We can develop audit work papers and reconciliations tailored to suit your specific audit requirements

claims.text: Accounten offers outsourced virtual CFO services to small and medium businesses.
claims.quote: outsourced CFO services to provide business analysis and insights to assist business growth

claims.text: Its bookkeeping service covers cloud software integration, day-to-day operations and monthly reporting.
claims.quote: Services ranging from cloud software integration, day-to-day operations to monthly reporting

claims.text: Accounten's workforce is distributed across Australia, India and the Philippines.
claims.quote: Its workforce is distributed across Australia, India, and Philippines.

claims.text: Accounten lists Xero in its technology stack and is categorised as a Xero partner.
claims.quote: Tech Stack: microsoft, microsoft office, xero

claims.text: Accounten offers its services with no lock-in contracts.
LinkedIn shows Accounten at 4 people, growing 14.3% year on year.
Jonathan So is listed as the other Director of Accounten.

hooks.text: Amanda's audit and assurance background plus an audit-preparation service means reconciliations with a traceable trail matter to her.
Offshore team across India and the Philippines makes reviewable, consistent reconciliation output valuable.
Virtual CFO work sits on top of clean books.

risks.text: Very small team (about 4 people), so budget and volume may be limited.

gaps: No blog posts, podcasts, press, job ads or dated social posts found.
Xero partner status taken from LinkedIn company profile only, not Xero directory.
